listing.title: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair Hackathon | La Familia Track
listing.description:
About La Familia

Somos La Familia, the leading Solana builder community in Spain. Our focus is all about onboarding, supporting, and scaling high-quality builders. We're deeply connected with developers, founders, and other ecosystem players throughout Spain and Spanish-speaking regions. For the Frontier Hackathon, we're doubling down on solidifying Spain's reputation as a serious builder hub within the Solana ecosystem.

Mission

Our mission for this Crypto World's Fair Hackathon track is to foster the creation of real, impactful products on Solana that have genuine potential for adoption, moving beyond typical hackathon submissions. We want to see projects that can truly leverage the Solana ecosystem and grow.

Hackathon Track Scope

We're looking for projects that demonstrate real-world use cases and strong technical foundations within the Solana ecosystem. We want to see products with clear distribution potential. Bring us your innovative ideas that can push the boundaries of what's possible on Solana.

Eligibility

To be eligible for this track, participants must meet the following criteria:

  • Submissions must be made on Colosseum and mark “SPAIN” as your country

  • Projects must also be submitted on Superteam Earn.

  • Projects must comply with all official Hackathon rules:

Judging Criteria

Submissions will be evaluated based on the following:

  • Ecosystem Impact: How significantly does the project contribute to and benefit the Solana ecosystem?

  • Product-Market Fit: Does the project address a genuine need or solve a clear problem for a defined user base?

  • User Growth & Distribution Potential: The project's ability to attract and retain users, and its strategy for broader adoption.

Reward Structure

  • 1st Place: 2000 USDG

  • 2nd Place: 1000 USDG

  • 3rd Place: 1000 USDG

  • 4th Place: 1000 USDG

Participants in this track will receive priority support from La Familia throughout the hackathon. This includes access to mentorship for both technical challenges and product development. We're also offering a dedicated build station in Madrid, "El Taller," to help teams collaborate and build effectively: https://luma.com/wpfunpri
